response.sql:
WITH invoice_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS total_cost_to_price_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost_to_price_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM invoice_metrics
)
SELECT
    AVG(im.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
    AVG(im.total_cost_to_price_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(im.total_cost_to_price_ratio - oa.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_metrics im
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE im.total_cost_to_price_ratio > oa.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice with a zero or missing sum of product_price has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the overall average and kept invoices; SQL aggregates ignore missing values.
